questions.q: Which is the best data type for storing a phone number such as 07700 900123?
questions.why: A phone number is not used in calculations and may start with 0, so it is stored as text.

questions.q: What is the main difference between a function and a procedure?
questions.why: A function returns a value with RETURN; a procedure does not.

questions.q: An array is declared as ARRAY[1:5, 1:8]. How many elements does it hold?
Explain why a local variable is better than a global variable.
questions.model: A local variable exists only in the subroutine where it is declared, so other parts of the program cannot change it by mistake, making errors less likely. Its memory is released when the subroutine ends and the same name can be reused elsewhere.
points: Can only be used/changed in its own subroutine
Memory freed after subroutine / name reuse
